p:name.p:item: Error of CC-Link IE TSN Class storage limitation

p:comment.p:item: The storage count of CC-Link IE TSN Class has reached the maximum.
CC-Link IE TSN Class change performed after this error occurs will not be stored into the non-volatile memory.
Error can not be stored because an error was detected in the access of the non-volatile memory.

- Errors that occurred before this error may not be stored in the non-volatile memory. - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
IP address can not be stored because an error was detected in the access of the non-volatile memory.

- IP address is not stored in the non-volatile memory. - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Module parameter can not be stored because an error was detected in the access of the non-volatile memory.

p:name.p:item: Non-volatile memory access error (CC-Link IE TSN Class)

p:comment.p:item: CC-Link IE TSN Class can not be stored because an error was detected in the access of the non-volatile memory.

- CC-Link IE TSN Class is not stored in the non-volatile memory. - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
IP address/station number setting was executed with the engineering tool when the IP address setting switch is set to 1 to 255.
To set the IP address with the engineering tool, turn on the power supply of the target analog module while the IP address/station number setting switch in is set to 0.
For the analog module which started firmware update, IP address setting by engineering tool was carried out.
After having carried out power off and on the module, please carry out IP address setting by engineering tool again.
IP address setting by engineering tool was carried out after the communication start with master station.

The analog module stored set IP address in non-volatile memory, but change of IP address is not reflected in module operation, and work in IP address before change. Please carry out power off and on the module or remote reset. In this way, change of IP address is reflected by module operation.

p:name.p:item: Module power supply voltage drop error

p:comment.p:item: Module power supply voltage dropped.
- Check the status of the module power supply. - Check whether the power supply voltage satisfies the specifications of the analog module.

p:name.p:item: Remote reset not possible error (N/W mode setting)

p:comment.p:item: The function setting switch 1 is set differently than when the unit is powered on, so the remote reset could not be performed.
Return the function setting switch 1 to the setting when the unit power was turned on, and then perform remote reset again.

p:name.p:item: Remote reset not possible error (link speed setting)

p:comment.p:item: In the link speed setting function, remote reset cannot be performed due to the following reasons. - The link speed different from the operating link speed was set. - Could not access the link speed stored in non-volatile memory.
- Power off and on the module. - Set the link speed again.
For the analog module which started firmware update, indicator display (start or stop) was carried out.
After having carried out power off and on the module, please carry out indicator display again.

p:name.p:item: Synchronous communication error (time synchronization accuracy error)

p:comment.p:item: During synchronous communication with the master station, the difference between the master station's time and its own time exceeded 1us.

- Connect the same number of device stations to each port of the master station. - Reconnect device stations after the analog module to a different port on the master station. - Check that there is no communication error at the another station. - Check if another station has been remote reset. - Take measures against noise on the transmission path.
If the error recurs after performing these steps, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

The parameter data stored in the non-volatile memory are faulty.

- Set the parameters of the non-volatile memory to default value by turning the module power off and on after turning Parameter area initialization command (address: 1002H) to without command(0) →with command(1)→ without command(0). And then Correctly set the parameters. - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
IP address and subnet mask stored in the non-volatile memory are faulty.

- The module will be automatically recovered immediately after the error occurs. But the IP address and subnet mask stored will be lost, and will operate as follows. IP address: 192.168.3.250 Subnet mask: 255.255.255.0 - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Link speed stored in the non-volatile memory are faulty.

- The module will be automatically recovered immediately after the error occurs. When started by module power off and on, the stored link speed will be lost, and the operating is performed according to the link speed stored as 1Gbps. When started by remote reset, it is operating at the link speed at the time of remote reset. - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

p:name.p:item: Non-volatile memory data error (CC-Link IE TSN Class)

p:comment.p:item: CC-Link IE TSN Class stored in the non-volatile memory are faulty.

- The module will be automatically recovered immediately after the error occurs. But the CC-Link IE TSN Class stored will be lost, and the operation will be carried out according to be saved as CC-Link IE TSN Class B. - To reduce noise, take measures such as the use of shielded cables for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

p:name.p:item: Unsupported CC-Link IE TSN Class setting error

p:comment.p:item: The firmware version used has an unsupported CC-link IE TSN Class setting.
Set the CC-link IE TSN Class setting supported by the used firmware version.
Time synchronization is abnormal, when the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication function is used.

- Check that the system configuration meets the specifications by referring to the master station manual. - Check that there is no communication error at the another station. - Check if another station has been remote reset. - Take measures against noise on the transmission path. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
When using the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication function, synchronous communication with the master station was not performed for a certain period of time.

- For the synchronization cycle setting for the master station, set a long cycle. - Reduce the number of device stations operating with the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication function. - Take measures against noise on the transmission path. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

p:name.p:item: Operating condition setting change disable error

p:comment.p:item: When the output range switch enable/disable setting is set to enable, the module parameter will be initialized by turning off and on Initial data setting request flag (RY9), writing the parameter with an engineering tool, or executing Parameter area initialization command (address: 1002H).

To execute the operation of turning off and on Initial data setting request flag (RY9), writing the parameter with an engineering tool, or executing Parameter area initialization command (address: 1002H), set the output range switch enable/disable setting to disable.
Module hardware error.
- Power off and on the module. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Invalid network settings were received.
- Power off and on the module. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Network settings that cannot be supported by the analog module were received.

- Check whether the model name of the device station set in the network configuration settings matches the model name of the actual device. - When an error occurs even if the model name matched, update the analog units to the latest firmware. - If this occurs with the latest firmware, the unit may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
The overlap of IP address was detected.
Change the IP address to avoid overlap with other IP addresses in the access range of CC-Link IE TSN. And then turn off and on the module power supply.
A value that cannot be used by the analog module was set in the settings of IP address and subnet mask.

- The operation is performed with the IP address and subnet mask which was set before the preset, without using the preset IP address and subnet mask. - The preset IP address, subnet mask will not be stored into the non-volatile memory. - Check the IP address and subnet mask, and change them to the values that can be used to the analog module. And then, turn off and on the module power supply.
Network synchronous communication setting of the analog module was set to "Synchronous".
- Set network synchronous communication setting of the analog module to "Asynchronous". - Update firmware to the latest version for the analog module.
RX/RY that the number of points cannot be supported by the analog module was set.
Check the number of RX and RY points and set them to 128 points or less in the network configuration settings.
RWr/RWw that the number of points cannot be supported by the analog module was set.
Check the number of RWr and RWw points and set them to 128 points or less in the network configuration settings.

In synchronous communication mode, the system area (RWwF/RWrF) is not assigned using the RWw/RWr setting of the network configuration settings.
Set the system area (RWwF/RWrF) to be assigned using the RWw/RWr setting of the network configuration settings.
The synchronization cycle set in the master station is not supported by the module.
Check the synchronization cycle of the master station, and then turn off and on the module power supply or perform remote reset.
